title: Lgiws Core
description: Mod that blocks the use of commands by player in chat.
body:
## Greetings, friends!
This mod performs a simple, but very important task for many players. Namely, it blocks the execution of commands by players in the game chat.

This is great for map creators so that players do not cheat in their walkthrough, or for assembling with friends so that there is no temptation to use commands.

The mod is client-side, of course.

## F.A.Q

**Q:** Is the execution of commands using command blocks blocked?
**A:** No, it is performed as before.

**Q:** Is there any way to use a command through a chat with the mod?
**A:** Yes, in fact there is and it is made specifically. Use **veystreks** instead of slash and the command will be executed.
